question: In a certain code language, 'GERMAN' is written as 'HFSLZM', and 'RUSTIC' is written as 'SVTSHB'. How will 'DIVIDE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'GERMAN' is written as 'HFSLZM'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c782aaff302808f3a637b90b3e96704fd23d612f52875829dd95fd517848760f.png] 

'RUSTIC' is written as 'SVTSHB'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63504a2f0dec146c9947079afec213d235b50c15b4cce63dbab7c8508f97c1b1.png] 

Similarly, for 'DIVIDE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7caf88214c8384b63361ba2a162f062b3027ee3809bd48940e33ccf0128e053.png] 

So, 'DIVIDE' will be written as 'EJWHCD'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
